answer: Require each agent to bond a fixed amount of the economy’s scarce token before it can place orders, and cap its influence by the amount bonded rather than by its number of names. Splitting one account into a nebula of fake agents then adds no voting or trading weight; gaining more requires buying and locking more tokens, which raises the attacker’s cost and ties up capital that cannot earn elsewhere. A jetty-like entry gate can make that cost visible before a sybil spiral begins.
